title: KeePass user configuration
whyItMatters: The per-user KeePass config can list recently opened password databases. It shows a password manager was used and where its metadata lives.
source: KeePass help, Configuration: local config at %APPDATA%/KeePass/KeePass.config.xml - https://keepass.info/help/v2/setup.html
notes: Config only. KeePass .kdbx databases can be stored anywhere the user chose and are not searched. The XML file is never opened or parsed.

cleanup.exportFirst: Make sure every KeePass database you need is copied to a drive you keep, and that you know its master password.
steps: Delete the KeePass configuration file named in the plan.
cleanup.risk: KeePass forgets its recent databases and window settings; the encrypted database files themselves are not touched.
